data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'B-H-Y', Bahayah means 'Radiant' or 'Shining One'. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to girls who are believed to bring light and joy into the world. The name Bahayah carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahayah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
